SoldierPartnerGroup.1.2:
When a New Star Guild member casts a skill, all New Star Guild members gain Daisy.
Daisy: Increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK by 5%, and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_CritPower" tint></color>Crit DMG by 10%.
When the total stacks of Daisy on the field reach 30, activates Triple Nova.
Triple Nova: Increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_RecoveryEnergy" tint></color>Energy Recovery Efficiency by 20%, and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_CritRate" tint></color>Crit Rate by 100% for all members for 5s. Clears all Daisy from the field when it ends.
SoldierPartnerGroup.10.2:
Gains bonus <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Coin" tint></color>Gold through multiple sources. Each <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Coin" tint></color>Gold gained from this Trait grants 1 stack of Performance.
Performance: Each stack grants United Harvest members 2% <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_MaxHp" tint></color>Max HP and 5% <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK.
Current Performance Stacks: <color=#f98037>==HARVEST==</color>
SoldierPartnerGroup.11.2:
Triggers Natural Growth once at fixed intervals.
Natural Growth: Restores 3% of <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_MaxHp" tint></color>Max HP to Offense members, effect doubled for Forest Friend members.
SoldierPartnerGroup.12.2: Once the battle starts, Sherlock sacrifices all other Forest Friends when it is deployed. Sherlock inherits their <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_MaxHp" tint></color>Max HP, then recovers HP equal to the total amount inherited.
SoldierPartnerGroup.13.2: For each Survival Expert member on the field, increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_MaxHp" tint></color>Max HP of all allied members.
SoldierPartnerGroup.14.2:
Increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK of all allied members by 3%. Activates Holy Aegis for the Offense member with the highest ATK.
Holy Aegis: Increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK by 30%, <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_AtkSpd" tint></color>ATK SPD by 50%, and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_RecoveryEnergy" tint></color>Energy Recovery Efficiency by 25%.
SoldierPartnerGroup.15.2: All allied members gain <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_CritRate" tint></color>Crit Rate. Dead Shot members gain an additional boost.
SoldierPartnerGroup.16.2:
When an Apex Warrior member casts a skill, gains 1 stack of Warrior Momentum (up to 5 stacks).
Warrior Momentum stacks increase <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG.
SoldierPartnerGroup.17.2:
When a Charm Aura member casts a skill, applies Charm to all enemies.
Charm: Increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_DmgPlusRcd" tint></color>DMG taken by 10% for 8s.
SoldierPartnerGroup.18.2: Each different Trait activated increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_CritRate" tint></color>Crit Rate.
SoldierPartnerGroup.19.2:
Master Slacker members enter Relaxing State periodically. At the end of battle in Encounter nodes, gain EXP equal to the number of Master Slacker members on the field.
Relaxing State: Cannot actively use Skills or Auto Attacks; decreases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_DmgPlusRcd" tint></color>DMG taken by 25%.
SoldierPartnerGroup.2.2:
When a Post Haste member's skill deals DMG, applies Wet Mist to the target, up to 1 stack every 0.5s.
Wet Mist: Decreases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_AtkSpd" tint></color>ATK SPD by 5%, and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_GenDmg" tint></color>DMG dealt by 5% for 10s.
SoldierPartnerGroup.20.2: Summons a Heavenly Chromatic Blaster to assist in battle, which continuously fires fireworks at random enemies. The firing rate scales with the total star level of Loong members.
SoldierPartnerGroup.21.2: Enhances White Cat Troupe members' skills.
SoldierPartnerGroup.22.2:
Summons a Desert Golem to assist in battle.
The Desert Golem unlocks more skills as the Trait level increases, and its <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_MaxHp" tint></color>Max HP and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Atk" tint></color>ATK scale with the total star level of Desert Scorpion members.
SoldierPartnerGroup.23.2:
Whenever an enemy dies, Sentinel of Dawn members immediately gain Hunt is On.
Hunt is On: Increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG by 60%. Casting a skill consumes 1 stack of Hunt is On.
SoldierPartnerGroup.24.2: Randomly triggers a weather effect at the start of battle. Navigation Expert members gain additional bonuses and are immune to severe weather.
SoldierPartnerGroup.25.2: All allied members gain <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_CritPower" tint></color>Crit DMG. Ace Agent members gain an additional boost.
SoldierPartnerGroup.26.2: Any member sharing at least one other Trait with a Commander member becomes its Follower. When a Commander casts a skill, Followers receive various Morale Beacon bonuses. This effect is disabled if there are 2 or 3 Commanders on the field.
SoldierPartnerGroup.27.2: Glamour Magic members gain a <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG bonus and Dual Cast. Reduces the second skill cast's effectiveness.
SoldierPartnerGroup.28.2:
Dealing Auto ATK DMG grants Suppressive Fire members stacking <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_AtkSpd" tint></color>ATK SPD (up to 1 stack every 0.5s, max 20 stacks).
At max stacks, they gain an additional 60% <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_NormalDmg" tint></color>Auto ATK DMG.
SoldierPartnerGroup.29.2: All allied members gain <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_RecoveryEnergy" tint></color>Energy Recovery Efficiency. Erudite members gain an additional boost.
SoldierPartnerGroup.3.2:
When any member in the Assist Slots casts a skill, Petal Bloom members immediately gain <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Energy" tint></color>Energy, and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG increases.
- The star level of Assist Petal Bloom members doubles the <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG increase of Offense Petal Bloom members. Effects of different members stack.
- 1/2/3★ Petal Bloom members provide a 1/2/3× increase to <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG.
SoldierPartnerGroup.30.2: All allied members restore <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Hp" tint></color>HP equal to a percentage of <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_GenDmg" tint></color>DMG dealt. They also gain a Shield equal to a percentage of their current <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Hp" tint></color>HP 10s after the battle starts.
SoldierPartnerGroup.31.2: When a Chivalry member casts a skill, it grants a shield to another deployed member with the lowest Shield.
SoldierPartnerGroup.32.2:
Dealing <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_NormalDmg" tint></color>Auto ATK DMG grants Weapon Master members 1 stack of Build-Up. Casting a skill consumes all Build-Up to grant an equal number of Aftershock stacks.
Build-Up: Each stack increases <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG by 20%.
Aftershock: Auto Attacks consume 1 stack to deal an additional 60% <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_NormalDmg" tint></color>Auto ATK DMG.
SoldierPartnerGroup.33.2: Activates an effect when Firstlight Noya enters the field.
SoldierPartnerGroup.34.2: Activates an effect when Mistique enters the field.
SoldierPartnerGroup.35.2: Activates an effect when Otoha enters the field.
SoldierPartnerGroup.36.2: Activates a synergy effect when Nanoha and Otoha are on the field together.
SoldierPartnerGroup.37.2: Activates a synergy effect when Nazuna and Sherlock are on the field together.
SoldierPartnerGroup.4.2:
When a Grace Imperium member casts a skill, it applies Grace Marks to all enemies. When members inflicted with Grace Marks are defeated, their current Grace Mark stacks are transferred to their nearest allied member of the same faction.
Sanction Mark: Loses HP equal to 10% of the total ATK of all surviving Grace Imperium members every 2s for 8s.
Reckoning Mark: Loses HP equal to 20% of the total ATK of all surviving Grace Imperium members every 2s for 8s.
SoldierPartnerGroup.5.2: Neo Grace Organization members in the Assist Slots gain boosted <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_SkillDmg" tint></color>Skill DMG and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_RecoveryEnergy" tint></color>Energy Recovery Efficiency.
SoldierPartnerGroup.6.2: At the start of battle, Imperial Guard members gain increased initial <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_Energy" tint></color>Energy and <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_RecoveryEnergy" tint></color>Energy Recovery Efficiency.
SoldierPartnerGroup.7.2:
Trekker Association members gain Support Fire at fixed intervals.
Support Fire: Increases Final DMG dealt by Auto Attacks and skills by 20%.
SoldierPartnerGroup.8.2: When deployed, increases specific stats for the squad. Freelance Trekker members gain an additional 100% boost.
SoldierPartnerGroup.9.2:
When Ashwind Clan members deal DMG to an enemy, they apply Besieged for 5s.
Ashwind Clan members deal 20% increased <color=#f98037><sprite name="Soldier_00_PartnerAttr_GenDmg" tint></color>DMG to Besieged targets.
